Name: Speremint's More Hairstyles for Fashion Sense
Author: perseidipity
Description:
Decided to dip my toes into SDV modding by porting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/91]Speremint's "More Hairstyles" mod[/url] to work in Fashion Sense.

I also made minor edits to a few hairs (see images).


[size=3][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Download & unzip the file into [b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods [/b]or import with your choice of mod manager (I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url])


[b][size=3]Uninstallation[/size][/b]

Remove the [i][FS] speremint's More Hairstyles for Fashion Sense[/i]  folder from your mods folder.


[size=3][b]Thanks[/b][/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33124356]Speremint[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/91]More Hairstyles[/url] mod & granting permission for me to port it & make minor edits.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] mod, the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Creating-a-Content-Pack]wiki guide on creating Fashion Sense packs[/url], and the mod manager [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]
